title: A Healthy Diet
subtitle: 考点：一般过去时 / discuss my diet

dialogue.t: Lily, what did you eat for lunch?
I ate rice, fish and vegetables.
My mother and I discussed my diet last week.
She said I should eat more fruit and drink less cola.
I drink a glass of milk every morning.
Good! Milk is good for you.
